description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects repeated traversal components in the Accept content-negotiation header.
affected_versions: Rails https://github.com/rails/rails: 5.2.2.1, 5.1.6.2, 5.0.7.2, 4.2.11.1; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects repeated traversal components in the Accept content-negotiation header.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Nonstandard legitimate Accept values containing filesystem traversal are denied.
